review.body: { let cause = * self . last_refusal . lock () . unwrap_or_else (std :: sync :: PoisonError :: into_inner) ; self . end . send_if_modified (| state | { if * state == EndState :: Live { * state = EndState :: Ended (cause) ; true } else { false } }) ; let _unconsumed = self . take_server_error () ; for task in & self . tasks { task . abort () ; } }
review.item_premise: Teardown publishes the relay refusal already recorded when the session is dropped, before aborting owned tasks. Its observed take of an unconsumed closed answer carries no diagnostic content; no server request or secret exposure is added.
